package usecase

import (
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

func passedTargetEvidence(steps []domain.Step, assisted bool) ([]ports.TargetEvidence, error) {
	indexes := make(map[string]int)
	evidence := make([]ports.TargetEvidence, 0)
	for _, step := range steps {
		if !step.Required {
			continue
		}
		if step.Status != "PASSED" || strings.TrimSpace(step.ID) == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		for _, target := range step.Targets {
			if (target.Type != "concept" && target.Type != "capability") || target.Key == "" || target.Version == "" {
				return nil, domain.ErrAuthoringDefect
			}
			key := target.Type + "\x00" + target.Key + "\x00" + target.Version
			index, exists := indexes[key]
			if !exists {
				index = len(evidence)
				indexes[key] = index
				independence := 1.0
				if assisted {
					independence = 0
				}
				evidence = append(evidence, ports.TargetEvidence{Target: target, Correctness: 1, Independence: independence, Confidence: 1})
			}
			evidence[index].StepIDs = append(evidence[index].StepIDs, step.ID)
		}
	}
	if len(evidence) == 0 {
		return nil, domain.ErrAuthoringDefect
	}
	return evidence, nil
}
